# Nusra Tax & Notary

> Professional tax preparation, notary services, immigration form assistance, defensive driving, and business services for Queens, NY and surrounding communities. Serving since 2020.

## Services

- [Tax Preparation](/tax-preparation) — Professional tax filing for individuals and businesses
- [Notary Services](/notary-services) — Certified NY Notary Public, online notarization available
- [Immigration Form Assistance](/immigration-form-assistance) — Help with immigration paperwork and forms
- [Defensive Driving](/defensive-driving) — Approved defensive driving courses
- [TLC Transportation](/tlc-translation) — TLC license and transportation services
- [Business Services](/business-services) — Corporation setup and business assistance
